details: @lyyncode/lyyn-bail is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that silently subscribes the installer's own WhatsApp account to WhatsApp Channels chosen by the publisher. lib/Utils/messages-media.js exports loadBase, which makeNewsletterSocket (lib/Socket/newsletter.js) calls on every socket creation as loadBase(newsletterWMexQuery, QueryIds). 80 seconds later it fetches a channel list from a URL stored as base64 and, 5 seconds apart, calls newsletterWMexQuery(id, QueryIds.FOLLOW) for each entry with the victim's authenticated session, swallowing errors. Nothing is logged and the README does not mention it. 8.0.8 to 9.0.4: lib/Utils/messages-media.js sha256 657662b2ae2e8cc1808715d8219d4e7ca7182f6eacda8d79b1cee4b721c88939 (byte-identical to @rixxcodex/baileys 8.2.0), URL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skyzopedia/Screaper/refs/heads/main/idChannel.json (23 channel IDs on 2026-11-06). 9.0.5: sha256 810d8f9f6b369ba64a3760beea0c0ccfd449399da2d8aedb458d7ce168394963, URL https://ch-lyyncode.vercel.app/lyyn. 9.0.6 to 9.0.8: sha256 20563d8117ea37b0df09bc579be38b153000c881022e62536b30b081a41712a4, URL https://ch-rho.vercel.app/lyyn (1 channel ID on 2026-11-06). Same behaviour as the PhantomSub family (MAL-2026-17342). Amazon Inspector described the same loadBase loop in @rixxcodex/baileys (MAL-2026-16483). CyberXYZ read every published version statically from the npm registry tarballs on 2026-11-06 (integrity verified); nothing was executed.
